note: React Native's own text fields, built by the React Native lab app alone (fixtures/apps/rn, src/ReactNative.tsx; scripts/truth/schema.ts#appOf) — round 7, calibration.json #18's field half: mp-native's RN field lists its own scroll indicator (`container 'Horizontal scroll bar, 1 page'`) under the field, over its floating label, which neither SwiftUI's TextField nor UIKit's UITextField does. rn-field: N a single-line TextInput's floating label (mp-native's SWIFT payee field), I the field with an icon (a trailing 44-pt icon button labelled Clear, a label target), M a multiline TextInput's label (its field laid as N's, from 1 pt below the label's top; its text view lists the `Horizontal scroll bar, 1 page` over the label's centre) — each target on a box of its colour, its field identified lab.<cell>.<tag>.field; a tap on a label focuses its field (logged as the target's tap), the icon's press empties its field. Every field reports its value and focus (LabState.fields, by the target's tag): the live golden's forms cases on the RN fields. rn-format (D18): rn-field's single-line field whose onChangeText reformats as it is typed (`format`: G an IBAN grouped in fours, A an amount's thousands — schema.ts#FieldFormat). rn-format-eager (L7): rn-format's shape with its own fields (rn-format has captures) — E an IBAN grouped in fours with an eager space as each group ends (`group4eager`, D60: on iOS the one path where a fill's typing can drop a tail behind an eager mark), P a phone number in threes (`phone3`). rn-banner (round 9, lab note LR3, docs/bugs/2026-10-19-lab-ios-wda-lists-react-native-views-by-their-frames-top-not-in-draw-order.md; `declared: covered`, golden-spec/covered.ts): each target a coloured Pressable (a press logs its `tap`) with, as its LATER JSX sibling, an opaque cover drawn over its centre (no touch handler: a touch on it reaches no target) — T under a toast whose frame starts 10 pt ABOVE T's top, an accessible view labelled `Saved` (`<tag>.cover`); U under a bare View of the same frame with an identifier only (lab.<cell>.U.cover, no label: the shape the structural excuse reads as undrawn); C, the control, under a cover whose frame starts 10 pt BELOW its top, so iOS's top order and the draw order agree. React Native draws the cover over the target; WDA lists RN's views by their tops, so T's and U's covers come before them. rn-banner-role (Android only, backlog D77 sub-case b): rn-banner with each target and its cover inside a slot View carrying accessibilityRole `toolbar` (not flattened, `collapsable={false}`), which React Native dumps as `android.view.View` — the shape of a node provider's host, whose subtree the reading-order mark never reaches (ADR 0015's D75 residual, not narrowed). The slot View encloses its cover (the slot widened 20 pt left and right, 10 pt up and down; the target and the cover where rn-banner lays them), so no dumped bound is clipped to it. Expected red as LR4 (a `Tapped` on the cover), pinned in tests/ui-tree/draw-order-android-views-twin.test.ts.
